t: UBS reiterates Nvidia stock Buy rating on strong demand outlook By Investing.com

The chipmaker’s revenue guidance of $78 billion exceeded most investor expectations, according to UBS analyst Timothy Arcuri. The firm noted that demand commentary from the company was among the most bullish it has heard, with backlog now extending into calendar year 2027. The strong outlook comes as Nvidia maintains a revenue growth rate of 65% over the last twelve months, supporting its $4.56 trillion market capitalization.
